scripts.dev: wrangler d1 execute landing-bookings --local --file=schema.sql && wrangler dev
scripts.bookings: wrangler d1 execute landing-bookings --remote --command "SELECT slot, name, email, product, users FROM bookings ORDER BY slot DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.requests: wrangler d1 execute landing-bookings --remote --command "SELECT created_at, kind, name, email, substr(message, 1, 80) AS message FROM requests ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20"
